jobs.title: Project Manager (Public Warning)
jobs.jd_full:
Everbridge is a global leader in critical communications, public warning, and enterprise safety solutions. Our technology is trusted by governments, emergency services, and enterprises worldwide to help protect people and communities during their most critical moments.

We are seeking a Project Manager to join our team. Reporting to the Manager of Professional Services, this role plays a key part in the successful deployment of Everbridge solutions. You will serve as an integrated member of the Professional Services team, overseeing projects from initiation through completion while ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and on budget.

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for setting project timelines, assigning responsibilities, and tracking progress across all phases of implementation. Once systems are live, you will act as an internal advocate for Everbridge stakeholders, serving as an escalation point when needed to support smooth operations. You will also prepare and deliver regular status updates and reports to senior leadership.

What you’ll do:

    • Plan, organize and manage all phases of a project life cycle to ensure successful delivery. This includes developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals and success criteria, project milestones, and budgets.
    • Takes ownership and responsibility for project budget and timeline, issue management, risks, decisions and the overall success of a project.
    • Leads requirements gathering sessions and collaborates with project governance team to document and gain sign-off on all deliverables, including design documentation and user test plans.
    • Demonstrates the ability to understand the operating styles of others as well as team/client relationships, team dynamics, and adjusts behavior accordingly to succeed.
    • Support the formal governance model supplied by the customer
    • Recognizes environmental or cultural nuances and adapts.
    • Track project performance, specifically to analyze the successful completion of short and long-term goals
    • Meet budgetary objectives and adjust project constraints based on financial analysis
    • Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders
    • Perform risk management to minimize project risks
    • Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors
    • Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
    • Meet with clients to take detailed ordering briefs and clarify specific requirements of each project
    • Willing to maintain a flexible schedule to collaborate with delivery team members in Europe, Asia, and the US, when needed, and open to traveling to these locations occasionally for training.
    • Track customer satisfaction KPIs. Develop and manage action plan to continuously improve these metrics.
    • Troubleshoot customer concerns and work with management team to ensure that critical issues are documented and escalated in an expeditious manner for resolution
    • Serve as a customer advocate within Everbridge and report customer feedback internally to Account Management, Product Management and Engineering

What you’ll bring:

    • Bachelor’s in business, Computer Science or related a plus
    • Extensive experience in a customer-facing role is required
    • Experience in deploying systems in either International Telco or Government domain
    • Significant experience of managing large, technical projects
    • Proven experience working in a matrix environment, managing multiple stakeholders
    • Works effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities
    • Strong project management skills (PMP Certified or at minimum CAPM)
    • Ability to handle & support conflicting priorities
    • Working knowledge of highly available architectures, computer security, telephony, and networking.
    • Proven track record in coordinating internal departments and resources to solve complex customer support or implementation problems.
    • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
    • Strong critical thinking, analytic, and problem-solving abilities
    • Ability to facilitate and lead cross-functional teams
    • High energy level and a “can do” attitude
    • Strong time management skills with proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite, and web-based applications
    • Understand Business Continuity or Emergency Management practices

About Everbridge

Everbridge empowers enterprises and government organizations to anticipate, mitigate, respond to, and recover stronger from critical events. In today’s unpredictable world, resilient organizations minimize impact to people and operations, absorb stress, and return to productivity faster when deploying critical event management (CEM) technology. Everbridge digitizes organizational resilience by combining intelligent automation with the industry’s most comprehensive risk data to Keep People Safe and Organizations Running™. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (US - ET)
jobs.jd_full:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Senior Product Manager at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

This is a remote role that must be based in Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

Our Organization

Strong Families cultivates people power by deeply caring for our communities, growing our collective leadership, and centering the lived experiences of people most impacted to shape meaningful change.
